name: @landbright/persistence
description: Landbright's database: the Prisma schema and migrations, the tenant-scoped transaction, the audit chain, the bootstrap.

scripts.migrate: node scripts/prisma.mjs migrate deploy && node scripts/prisma.mjs db execute --file prisma/dev-roles.sql
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/prisma.mjs generate && LANDBRIGHT_INTEGRATION=db vitest run test/rls.integration.test.ts
